states.revealedCondition: Box scratched because 57 (Africa) was still sealed.
states.revealedText:
Our scouts report that the Hollow Men have raided Africa. We quickly mobilized... but too late.

Open Package 7 and follow the instructions inside. (This does not complete any objectives.)

Destroy the "TOPAZ Experimental Vaccine" Unrationed Event card inside.

mechanics.whenRead: STOP. Draw and read during step 2 of the setup of the first game in July.
triggers: 57 (Africa) has not been opened: scratch the box.
destroys: The "TOPAZ Experimental Vaccine" Unrationed Event inside Package 7, if the box is scratched.
rules: If 57 is already open, scratch nothing.
If 57 is sealed, open Package 7 and follow the instructions inside.
Opening Package 7 this way does not complete any objectives.
Destroy the Unrationed Event named TOPAZ Experimental Vaccine that is inside the package.
Destroy this card after resolving it.
mechanics.notes: "Open Package 7" and "Destroy the \"TOPAZ Experimental Vaccine\" Unrationed Event card inside." are bold. 57 is in a red box. Side A is the same Stop face in state 2. The card does not itself say to open 57.
